description: This file implements a dynamic rate limiter for a machine learning proxy, managing TPM/RPM quotas per project based on current traffic, and tracking active projects. It includes classes for cache management and rate limiting logic, with hooks for pre- and post-call processing.

classes.name: DynamicRateLimiterCache
classes.description: A wrapper around DualCache to manage active project counts per model per minute.

classes.name: _PROXY_DynamicRateLimitHandler
classes.description: Handles rate limiting logic, including checking available usage and hooks for pre- and post-call processing.

methods.name: async_get_cache
methods.description: Retrieves the count of active projects for a given model in the current minute.

methods.name: async_set_cache_sadd
methods.description: Adds a set of project identifiers to the cache for a model in the current minute.

methods.name: update_variables
methods.description: Updates the router object used for model info and usage queries.

methods.name: check_available_usage
methods.description: Calculates available TPM and RPM for a model, considering current usage and active projects.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-call hook that checks rate limits before processing a request.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook
methods.description: Post-call hook that adds headers with rate limit info after a successful call.
